title: Smoothing with a loop
summary: average() over an array, and the SmoothedSpeed graph.

steps.title: Add them up
steps.say: A `for` loop visits every slot. Keep a running total, then divide by how many.

steps.title: Why average?
steps.say: Robot.java keeps the last 5 speeds and logs their average as `Robot/SmoothedSpeed`. Averaging hides the jitter, at the cost of reacting a little later.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: Raw speed
steps.say: Drive around a bit. In AdvantageScope, search for `LinearSpeed`, then drag **Robot/LinearSpeed** onto the **Left Axis**.

steps.title: Smoothed speed
steps.say: Now compare the averaged one. Which line is calmer? In AdvantageScope, search for `SmoothedSpeed`, then drag **Robot/SmoothedSpeed** onto the **Right Axis**.
